As we always say first thing in the morning “It’s going to be a GREAT DAY!

And it always is. It’s only 4:00pm and the day has flown by with many things accomplished!  

The Studio and Gallery look very sleepy and quiet from looking at the building but behind closed doors, Robert is waking up the studio by many different jobs today!

Phoenix our little kiln is just NOT a pretty face! She did a bisque last night and still hot enough to keep are coffees warm this morning 

Robert will be unloading her and then reloading her for a firing when big DraGON is done! Robert fully loaded him this morning with all kinds of soup latte in Swirl and a few Badlands 

We have 7 Swirl large vases and 4 in Badlands design so these are the first vases in this design so we are anxious to see how they will look!
EXCITING! 

I’ll keep you posted!!!

We have not seen those Swirl vases since the summer in early August so it will be lovely to have a few new vases the gallery to go along with our little Sand Dune vases!

It wasn’t long before we did a tour apt. for a couple going off Island. It was lovely to show Yvonne and Andre from Maine how the magic is all done! So a couple of Robert’s mugs and one of my hummingbird tiles will be going over to Maine with them  Thank you for your support of the craft, You two!❤️

After our company left Robert stayed to glaze and I quickly dunked a few of my ornaments for DraGON before Robert closed up the lid.

Quickly I ran in to Charlottetown to get my haircut done at Magicuts by my favourite girl Mihoko! We always have such a great time! And she did a great job!
She always makes me look and feel good and I’ll be already when we open up Saturday and Sunday! 
❤️✂️
Thanks Mihoko I love the way you cut my hair! You always get it right!

Then I was off to get pumpkins and gourds for the front of the shop. Just like that our summer was gone and now we are into the fall!
How did THAT happen so quick?

Still a beautiful season and a great time to get out and see nature’s beauty!

The yard looks lovely with the new fall decorations so if you are out this way on the Green Gableshore: Kensington, Stanley Bridge, New Glasgow, Rustico (North, South/Central) Cavendish Drive, make sure you take a stop in this weekend to 17 Broadway Road, Hope River, PEI

We are off of the St. Mary’s Road that runs between Stanley Bridge and New Glasgow! You’ll see the Robert McMillan Pottery blue government signs and also you will see our colourful Poppies Porch Chairs at the end of the drive by our sign.

Please feel free to stop in. Take a tour on the Studio floor and see where and how Robert McMillan makes and applies his multilayers of glazes! 

His pottery is microwave and dishwasher safe. Made by his hands for your hands! Handles that will hold your hand, perfectly! Come try one out!

The Gallery will be full of pretty items and if you are looking to buy that special gift or pre-Christmas order, this might be you new go to, pottery shop where you get to know your potter! 

We want our gallery ti be your new place to BE, have fun and enjoy an experience! ❤️

I’ll keep you posted with DraGONs opening when it happens -should be late tomorrow night! ❤️ and the colours amazing! 

You can also take advantage of our beautiful photo screen to get a great family/friends fall photo! Always a fun time ❤️

So come meet your potter and the Potter’s Wife of Hope River and join our fun filled gallery of music, laughter, stories and being social. We love our visitors so pop on by!

We’ll be seeing you soon

Stories of the Studio

And Just Like THAT It’s Fall

As we always say first thing in the morning “It’s going to be a GREAT DAY!

And it always is. It’s only 4:00pm and the day has flown by with many things accomplished!  

The Studio and Gallery look very sleepy and quiet from looking at the building but behind closed doors, Robert is waking up the studio by many different jobs today!

Phoenix our little kiln is just NOT a pretty face! She did a bisque last night and still hot enough to keep are coffees warm this morning 

Robert will be unloading her and then reloading her for a firing when big DraGON is done! Robert fully loaded him this morning with all kinds of soup latte in Swirl and a few Badlands 

We have 7 Swirl large vases and 4 in Badlands design so these are the first vases in this design so we are anxious to see how they will look!
EXCITING! 

I’ll keep you posted!!!

We have not seen those Swirl vases since the summer in early August so it will be lovely to have a few new vases the gallery to go along with our little Sand Dune vases!

It wasn’t long before we did a tour apt. for a couple going off Island. It was lovely to show Yvonne and Andre from Maine how the magic is all done! So a couple of Robert’s mugs and one of my hummingbird tiles will be going over to Maine with them  Thank you for your support of the craft, You two!❤️

After our company left Robert stayed to glaze and I quickly dunked a few of my ornaments for DraGON before Robert closed up the lid.

Quickly I ran in to Charlottetown to get my haircut done at Magicuts by my favourite girl Mihoko! We always have such a great time! And she did a great job!
She always makes me look and feel good and I’ll be already when we open up Saturday and Sunday! 
❤️✂️
Thanks Mihoko I love the way you cut my hair! You always get it right!

Then I was off to get pumpkins and gourds for the front of the shop. Just like that our summer was gone and now we are into the fall!
How did THAT happen so quick?

Still a beautiful season and a great time to get out and see nature’s beauty!

The yard looks lovely with the new fall decorations so if you are out this way on the Green Gableshore: Kensington, Stanley Bridge, New Glasgow, Rustico (North, South/Central) Cavendish Drive, make sure you take a stop in this weekend to 17 Broadway Road, Hope River, PEI

We are off of the St. Mary’s Road that runs between Stanley Bridge and New Glasgow! You’ll see the Robert McMillan Pottery blue government signs and also you will see our colourful Poppies Porch Chairs at the end of the drive by our sign.

Please feel free to stop in. Take a tour on the Studio floor and see where and how Robert McMillan makes and applies his multilayers of glazes! 

His pottery is microwave and dishwasher safe. Made by his hands for your hands! Handles that will hold your hand, perfectly! Come try one out!

The Gallery will be full of pretty items and if you are looking to buy that special gift or pre-Christmas order, this might be you new go to, pottery shop where you get to know your potter! 

We want our gallery ti be your new place to BE, have fun and enjoy an experience! ❤️

I’ll keep you posted with DraGONs opening when it happens -should be late tomorrow night! ❤️ and the colours amazing! 

You can also take advantage of our beautiful photo screen to get a great family/friends fall photo! Always a fun time ❤️

So come meet your potter and the Potter’s Wife of Hope River and join our fun filled gallery of music, laughter, stories and being social. We love our visitors so pop on by!

We’ll be seeing you soon
